VBO:0200218.summary: Braque is a grouping of continental pointing dogs. In FCI classification it includes French braques, the Portuguese Pointer and other distinct breeds, alongside separate spaniel-type and griffon-type pointing groups.
VBO:0200218.shortDescription: Braque-type dogs form one FCI grouping of continental pointers, including French and Portuguese breeds.

sources.title: FCI — Pointing Dogs
